book.name: MATTA
book.title: Matta Laɓara na Mbǝnggǝn aten Yeeso

content: Kyad Yeeso Urshalima hai ƙǝla kutǝra
Na Yeeso tǝ fatsahayighǝn a takh ndusang Urshalima fa, ɓa nda hu tala ɓa na nda aarha Mbetafaji ahu Wumngya ɗǝfya Dzaitun. Thlǝngga Yeeso fatsahayighǝn sǝri a ˈwa nda mbeeɗǝ.
Ndanggǝn kanda, “Ɗama hu talɗa ɗǝ na a mbǝɗi taarha, a kyaɗun sa hai, nun awal kwaara ƙǝƙǝna hai tǝ wanggǝn a thlǝmadghǝn. Kwasaman kanda hai mbee kanda nun ɓa.
A tsahang niifa mee kun, ndaman kee, ‘Na mid Chinǝm sǝ kanda,’ tsu a mbǝɗi kee nǝn a malang kun ɗun ɗǝ tǝ kanda.”
Katǝrana ǝnɗa haya ka lǝɗang ngganda ˈya ndaana annabi:

content.text: Nǝghǝn ɓayi a ƙǝsǝr wan kwaara.’”

content: Ɗǝgha fatsahayina ɗǝ ǝna nda kǝla ndangna Yeeso kanda.
Ɓang kwarɗa nda ɓa tǝ wan kwarɗi, lǝlǝɓang ngganda lukki ndan a ƙǝsǝr wan kwarɗa sǝ tsauka atenggǝn.
Lǝlǝɓangga fiya lukki ndan hai aten kwamana a mbedghǝn, fingya kǝm kyalth shiiya nda ɓa lǝlǝɓang ngganda a tǝn kwamana.
Nafiya ˈwagha mbeeɗǝ ma ndǝghǝn tǝ fingya na mbusamadghǝn tǝrang ngganda urayi ndan sǝ, kanda ndaarha:

content.text: niifɗi na ɓayi ahu thlǝm Chinǝm!
Falama Faara na manggǝn a talara!”

content: Kyana Yeeso a Urshalima hai, wupǝri ɗi kahad wulangga teena kanda, na nda tsakh miiya tǝ ndaarha “Wunni ya?”
Nggǝmangga nafini, “Yeeso ni, annabi ɗi ɓagha ɓa a Nadzarat na a Nggalili.”
Rǝghang Yeeso fa shafiliya ɗǝ a Wuri Faara

Kyagha Yeeso Kǝn Faara ɗǝ na Urshalima katǝranggǝn rǝghang nda nafiya ɗǝ na a hiirha tǝ hǝng nda maɓiya ɗǝ ka sataka. Changgǝlanggǝn tebǝrya fa mbeɗed wuɗǝɓǝlya ɗǝ tǝ kulohod fingya na a heng kataprakkya ɗǝ.
Ndanggǝn kanda, “Ndagha ɗeleewar Faara,
Ɓagha kwamaya ɓa tǝ sǝfǝngya a thlǝmadghǝn ɓa ahu Kǝn Faara, ƙǝnanggǝn kanda.

Amma nana mamngya firistaya tǝ famalǝmngya ngyakhrha Musa ǝnwultenggini ǝnanǝn, wundakhnaya ma kanda a huhwarha a pǝpal Ƙǝn Faara kanda ndaarha, “Faala tsauɗǝ aten Wan Ndauda.” Amma mamnggini sǝbgha hur ndan ɗǝ.
Tsahang mee nda Yeeso, “Sǝkna ǝnɗi na wanggini ndaarha ya wa?” Nggǝmangga Yeeso, “Hǝng, ˈWawa nun karatang nda ɗeleewar Faara wa? Ƙǝsǝr ndagha nda,

content.text: ‘Tsahang ɗun wundakhnaya ha tǝ wufar waya,

content: A mbǝɗi kee mal kanda nǝn wudgha Mbetani ɗǝ mǝngga hai a mbǝɗi.
Shiwang Yeeso Ɗǝf Shiɓaarha
Ɗalthna mbǝrha hai nanǝn a wutta Urshelima ɗǝ, ƙǝsgha miirha ndǝn.
Na shiɓarha nǝn a ƙǝlar kwamana, ɗǝgha thlǝmadghen ɗǝ kǝlagha hai ko wee a uradghǝn kǝl shiiya kee. Tǝrgha ndanggǝn shiɓadɗi, “Ma nggǝrna tam nggǝtta ɓalwa!” Tsu kee hwargha ɗǝfǝdɗa ɗǝ.
Nana fatsahayighǝn ǝnɗi katǝragha hai, ƙǝsgha ǝnwulteena kanda kaan, ndanda, “Ƙǝƙǝn hwarna shiɓadɗa ɗǝ ƙǝkar kee ya?”

Tǝrgha ndangga Yeeso kanda, “Niya pǝrang kǝkafek kun, anaɗun tǝ fǝrƙǝkafek fa ngaalanggun alten nun wa, nun a ǝna ǝngya kǝla yanɗiya, nduwa kalgha yanɗamu ya. Nun mbang ndang nda wumndǝɗi ya, ‘Thliusǝ muwana hu wuri aamɗa ɗǝ ya,’ nǝn a katǝrarha hai kee.
Nun hwanang Faara kala ˈya na minnun, a fǝrɗun kǝkafek, nun walghǝn.”
Tsakhmee aten sǝsǝmnda Yeeso

Wudna Yeeso ahu Ƙǝn Faara ɗǝ na a Urshelima katǝranggǝn tsaharhaha, Mamnda Firistayini tǝ shingya nafini ɓanda thlǝmadghǝn ɓa. Tsahang mee nda, “Tǝ sǝsǝmnda wun na ǝna ǝnggini hǝu ya? Wun fǝrowa sǝsǝmndǝɗi ya?”
Nggǝmangga Yeeso kanda, “Niya tsahang mee kun ha tal. A nggǝreeɗun sǝ, niya pǝranggǝn kun tǝ wun fǝreegha Sǝsǝmnda niya ǝna ǝngginiya.

Wun fǝrangga kwamana Yahaya ǝna mbaptisǝma nǝn? Faara fǝrangga wa, nduwa fiya wa?” Tǝrgha thliigha ngaala sǝ a pathlang ndan, ndaa nda, “A ndaa ɗǝm, ‘Faara fǝrangga,’ nǝn a tsakh mee, ‘Kama fǝrwa nun ƙǝkafek tǝghǝn?’”
“Amma a ndaɗǝm, ‘Fiya fǝrangga,’ nǝm a tǝrǝm fiya, ƙǝsǝr fǝr nda ƙǝkafek Yahaya annabi ni.”
A kwasamadghǝn nggǝrang ngganda sǝ, “Sǝngwan wa.” Tǝrgha ndanggǝn kanda, “Nggi ƙǝm mbi pǝranggǝn kun wun fǝreegha sǝsǝmnda niya ǝna ǝnggini ya wa.”
Karapu aten wundǝlaya sǝri
“Amma ma numa nun? Na niifa sǝ tǝ wundǝlayighǝn sǝri, ɗǝgha thlǝmad tǝ pamǝnda ɗǝ ndanggǝn, ‘Waana, a weeriya ɗǝwa ɗǝ ɗa ǝna taara ahu hed inabi.’
Tǝrgha ndagha wundǝladɗi, ‘Mbi ɗǝrha ɗǝ wa,’ amma numagha ɗǝgha ɗǝ.
Tǝrgha chin ɗǝgha thlǝmad tahad wundǝlad ɗaɗǝ ndanggǝn, ‘sa ɗǝwa ɗǝ,’ ndagha wundǝladɗi, ‘hǝng pǝpa, niya ɗǝrha ɗǝ.’ Amma ɗǝwa ɗǝ wa.”

“A hur ndan na sǝri ya yanggi ǝnagha ˈya na mid chin?” Nggǝra nda sǝ, “Yanɗi ˈwanǝn thlǝnda.” Ndangga Yeeso kanda, “Niya pǝrang kǝkafek kun, fathlǝ tsamngya tǝ susuwaya nanda ˈwarha hu kutǝryid Faara ɗǝ ma kun.”

Ƙǝsǝr Yahaya tǝ Mbaptisǝma ɓaɗa ɓa kyaɗang ɗǝ kwamana kun na a tsawun ngga a mbed Faara, amma fǝr wun kǝkafek wa, amma fathlǝ tsamngya tǝ susuwaya fǝr nda kǝkafek tǝghǝn. Ko nanun ǝnggini a katǝrarha hai, karɗun fa fǝrƙǝkafek nun tǝghǝn. 21:32 Luka 3:12; 7:29-30.
Karapu aten fahuɗaya nzǝmngga hed inabi

Nanǝnya kaaman thlǝmaarha asǝɗarha fa pak. Na niifa sǝ pagha wan ɗǝfya inabi, kanggǝn tǝ kalthmaana, ra mbǝd ˈyaɗa wan inabi nǝn ahurghǝn, nggǝrghǝn ra sǝfa na nzang na tǝƙǝla hedɗa ha a tsaurha a tenggǝn. Tǝrgha nzǝmang hed inabi ɗa nǝn fahuɗaya ha wii tala nǝn.
Tsǝna shifirha hai, thlǝn mafayighǝn nǝn ɗa nda thlang yighǝn ǝnnarhami ɓa.
Amma fa nzǝm heeyini kǝsang ngganda mafayini; ɗǝk tal nda, ɓǝlang ngganda tal, muk tahadghǝn nda tǝ ferya.
Tǝrgha nggǝrghǝn thlǝn fingya mafaya thlǝmad ndan ɗǝ, kalgha yanggini ˈwa nǝn thlǝn nda ɗǝ. Fa nzǝm hedɗi nggǝrgha nda ǝnang kanda kǝla yi ƙǝtǝm.
Akwasamadghǝn tǝ hedɗi thlǝn wan hurghǝn nǝn a thlǝman ndan ɗǝ nǝghǝn a numad ndaarha, “‘Mbǝ ngaala sǝ wa na nda fǝrang mamnggirha waana.’”
“Amma nana fa nzǝm heeyini wanɗi keeghǝn ɓayi, ndang ngganda ndan, ‘Yo, kulo tǝ har langaad hedɗi ɓayi ya. Taama ɓǝlanggǝm tǝnǝm har langaad hedɗi.’”
Tǝrgha ƙǝsang ngganda, kahang ngganda ƙǝsǝr kadɗa ɗǝ, ɓǝlang ngganda.
“A ɓad tǝ hedɗa ɓa, ma nǝn ǝnang nda fa nzǝm hedɗi?”
Mamngya fatakkwayini ndaa nda, “Nǝn a ɓǝlang fa mbǝlfeyini tǝ sǝsaarha na pǝɗaaghǝn, fǝrang hedɗa nǝn nafiya pak, na narha fǝrang yighǝn ǝnnarhami kala shifirha.”
Tǝrgha tsahangga Yeeso mee kanda, “ˈWawanun karatang nda ahu ɗeleewar Faara wa? Ndanǝn:
“Tsaunǝn kee, niya ndang nda kun, na nda a thlang nda kutǝryid Faara a harnun, fǝrang nggǝnda chehweeya na fǝr wan ɗǝfya ngga.”
Kala niifa mukka ten ferɗa hai, nǝn hwasarha fa ɓatal, ɓatal, amma yi mukna ferɗi tenggǝn hai nǝn a tsarang ɗǝ.
Sǝkna mamngya firistayini tǝ Farisayini karapu ɗi, walang ngganda nǝn a thlǝk asǝɗadɗi aten ndan kanda ni fahuɗayini na tǝ mbǝlfedɗa fa.
Na mid ndan sǝ a kǝsang ngganda, amma kanda tǝrǝm fiya wumngga hai, ƙǝsǝr na fiya a ndaarha annabi ni.
